name: Tasselthrash
description: Opens a formal exchange with a clean rising cut that tests the opponent's guard height.

name: Driftleap
description: Takes one gliding pace to fix the exact distance at which the duel will be fought.

name: Unyielding Guardwing
description: Holds the blade across the center line so the opponent has only one lane to attack.

name: Needling Flitter
description: Jabs the point at the opponent's sword hand to mark where the next thrust will land.

name: Staunch Jianhilt
description: Meets the opposing blade at the crossing point and answers with a cut along the same line.

name: Glamour Eddy
description: Chains three false thrusts at different heights to pull the opponent's guard apart.

name: Transfixing Springtip Onslaught
description: Commits the whole body and one held breath to a single thrust that ends the exchange.

name: Rippleassault
description: Sweeps the edge across the opponent's whole line of defense in the final pass of the duel.

name: Granite Waistbend
description: Cuts from a deep rooted stance so the full weight of the legs travels into the blade.

name: Liltpounce
description: Pushes off the back foot to cover a long pace without lifting the shoulders.

name: Flexgreave
description: Draws the sword elbow against the ribs to guard the body at short range.

name: Harpooning Springtip
description: Thrusts with the spine straight so the blade extends the line of the back.

name: Trouncing Twinspine
description: Sweeps the blade flat across with the weight transferring from rear foot to front.

name: Tasselbarrage
description: Drives a downward chop from the hip so the qi follows the turn of the whole body.

name: Immovable Pommeltuft
description: Wraps the blade around the shoulder line to turn a heavy cut away from the neck.

name: Skinning Knotcord
description: Draws the blade across the opponent with the entire body sinking backward through the pull.

name: Might Flexspine
description: Sends qi from the soles up through the spine into a thrust that pierces armor.

name: Ironeddy
description: Rolls the weight from leg to hip to shoulder into a heavy slash through a guard.

name: Resilient Guardwing
description: Parries in a small circle that carries the opposing blade out past the shoulder.

name: Eddysprint
description: Steps in on an orbiting path around the opponent's lead foot.

name: Ravaging Ridgecrest
description: Cuts in a full ring from the shoulder so the edge meets the opponent from the side.

name: Perceptive Knotcord
description: Holds the point at the center of the ring to feel where the opponent turns.

name: Eddy Thrash
description: Chains three ring cuts at rising heights so each follows the swing of the last.

name: Swirlassault
description: Sweeps qi along the edge through a full orbit that cuts all around the guard.

name: Mantled Twinspine
description: Weaves the blade in widening spirals before the body to catch every cut aimed inward.

name: Swirlbarrage
description: Swings one vast ring of qi-backed edge that cuts through everything inside its reach.

name: Manacling Knotcord
description: Tightens the ring of the blade around the opposing sword until it cannot leave the bind.

name: Aura Twinspine
description: Cuts with the qi field wrapped along the edge so it reaches a finger past the steel.

name: Nimbus Springtip
description: Thrusts with the field pushed ahead of the point to enter before the steel does.

name: Hardened Ridgecrest
description: Raises the guard with the field spread along the flat to blunt an incoming blow.

name: Driftjaunt
description: Slips sideways with the field trailing the blade to sense the opponent's reply.

name: Discerning Tassel
description: Lets the field extend along the blade to touch the opponent's weapon from a distance.

name: Sustaining Pommeltuft
description: Holds a stance while the field settles evenly along the length of the blade.

name: Liltassault
description: Slices with the field projecting the edge several hands beyond the physical tip.

name: Stifling Guardwing
description: Presses the field against the opposing blade at a distance to hold it in place.

name: Enduring Jianhilt
description: Throws the field outward in a wave from the parry to knock the opponent's blade away.

name: Glint Flitter
description: Drives the whole field forward along the blade as one lance that pierces at long reach.

name: Slagswirl
description: Sweeps the field edge across the whole front arc to cut every foe within reach.

name: Unshaken Twinspine
description: Turns the blade in one smooth arc so the opponent's cut slides away without a clash.

name: Eddycanter
description: Draws back a pace as the cut arrives so its force spends itself on empty air.

name: Annealed Waistbend
description: Steps across the opponent's line with the blade covering the body as it moves.

name: Verity Tassel
description: Brushes the opposing blade lightly to learn how heavy the next cut will be.

name: Quelling Flexspine
description: Slips into a bind and out of it again so the opponent's force pulls him off line.

name: Implacable Flexspine
description: Turns a guard into a cut by rolling the blade over the opposing sword.

name: Willowcloak
description: Spirals the opponent's heavy cut around the blade and returns it as a counter thrust.

name: Wrecking Springtip
description: Completes a full turn of the body after a parry into a slash that follows through.

name: Tearing Tassel
description: Cuts while the body and qi each follow their own track to the same point.

name: Flexspurt
description: Steps in two linked paces so the second foot lands as the cut arrives.

name: Unbroken Guardwing
description: Holds two guard lines at once with blade and free hand to cover high and low.

name: Lancing Flitter
description: Switches from the body track to the qi track mid-thrust so the point accelerates.

name: Mantled Knotcord
description: Parries by body movement alone while qi is held ready for the answering cut.

name: Mindful Ridgecrest
description: Reads the opponent's qi track along the blade while the body track stays still.

name: Meridian Springtip
description: Drives a thrust whose body track and qi track arrive at the same instant.

name: Resilient Pommeltuft
description: Rolls both wrists in a pair of linked turns to carry a cut off the line.

name: Enduring Twinspine
description: Parries with one edge and strikes back with the other in a paired motion.

name: Rippletorment
description: Merges the body track and qi track into a slash that carries both of their weights.

name: Severing Swirl
description: Cuts along both tracks at once in a pair of crossing strokes that sever a guard.

name: Driftthrash
description: Sweeps the blade out along one course and returns on the other in a continuous pass.

name: Steadfast Ridgecrest
description: Holds a high still guard with the blade raised like a hawk on its perch.

name: Discerning Guardwing
description: Fixes a steady gaze on the opponent's guard to find the gap before it opens.

name: Unmaking Flexspine
description: Cuts from the raised guard in a wide wing-spread arc across the opponent's body.

name: Tasselsprint
description: Drops forward from the perch on a long low step that closes the distance fast.

name: Transfixing Flitter
description: Thrusts down at the opponent's shoulder with the point clawing in like a talon.

name: Unflinching Jianhilt
description: Sweeps the blade up and out like a pinion to turn aside a cut at the head.

name: Ripplebarrage
description: Wheels around the opponent in a curve and slashes across the exposed flank.

name: Harrowing Springtip
description: Dives from the high guard in one plunging thrust with qi pressing the point forward.

name: Lilttorment
description: Rakes the edge across the opponent as the swordsman passes and does not stop.

name: Trouncing Ripple
description: Draws one long clean cut along a line that stretches past the opponent's shoulder.

name: Nimbus Drift
description: Thrusts upward from a low stance at a steep angle toward the opponent's throat.

name: Adamant Waistbend
description: Raises the blade overhead in an open guard that leaves the sight line clear.

name: Swirlleap
description: Takes a long even pace along a line that opens the angle for a cut.

name: Taut Knotcord
description: Reads the opponent's stance against the open horizon for signs of the coming cut.

name: Murk Flexspine
description: Flashes the edge against the light to veil the line of the following cut.

name: Resilient Springtip
description: Parries with a wide upward sweep that clears the whole upper body.

name: Driftassault
description: Slashes in a high arc that comes down on the opponent from above and behind.

name: Needling Swirl
description: Thrusts down from the highest point of the guard with the full length of the arm.

name: Willowplating
description: Spins the blade overhead into a rounded dome of qi that turns aside blows from above.

name: Skinning Flexspine
description: Cuts in a curve like a river bend that comes round the opponent's guard.

name: Unflinching Guardwing
description: Sets the blade low and wide like a basin's rim to catch cuts aimed at the legs.

name: Ripplejaunt
description: Crosses the opponent's line in two quick steps like fording a shallow river.

name: Remnant Twinspine
description: Feels the current of the opponent's movement along the blade to find where it flows.

name: Harpooning Flitter
description: Runs the point straight along the opponent's blade in a thrust that follows its channel.

name: Annealed Knotcord
description: Gathers the opponent's cut into a pooling parry and spills it off to one side.

name: Iron Twinspine
description: Brings two curving cuts together at the same point like two rivers meeting.

name: Downpour Eddy
description: Sweeps a rolling wave of qi along the ground that floods the footing of every foe ahead.

name: Grinding Pommeltuft
description: Cuts with the wind at the back so the oath of the school lends weight to the blade.

name: Driftspurt
description: Steps to face into the wind so the opponent must fight against it.

name: Unyielding Twinspine
description: Holds the guard on the sheltered side so the blade is never caught by a gust.

name: Chime Knotcord
description: Feels how the wind bends around the opponent to learn which way the body will turn.

name: Lancing Springtip
description: Thrusts the sworn edge forward on a gust so the point arrives before it is seen.

name: Steadfast Flexspine
description: Turns the blade with a gust to carry an incoming cut wide of the body.

name: Scalding Flitter
description: Slashes along a bearing held steady through a crosswind without wavering.

name: Gustswirl
description: Rides a rising wind into a thrust with an oath's worth of force behind the point.

name: Gust Ridgecrest
description: Sweeps the blade in widening arcs that gather the wind into a cutting gust.

name: Drubbing Jianhilt
description: Cuts along the line of a cliff rim with the open drop at the opponent's back.

name: Liltcanter
description: Walks the rim with short sure steps that never leave the ground long.

name: Hardened Springtip
description: Holds the guard from the higher footing so every cut from below loses force.

name: Scything Springtip
description: Thrusts straight along the cliffline so the opponent has nowhere to slip aside.

name: Verity Pommeltuft
description: Feels the updraft at the rim to judge how close the opponent stands to the drop.

name: Tasselassault
description: Slashes across the opponent while crossing the flat ground in one long stride.

name: Implacable Guardwing
description: Parries so that the opponent's cut is turned toward the drop and away from the body.

name: Hamstringing Ridgecrest
description: Binds the opposing blade and walks the opponent toward the rim.

name: Cleaving Swirl
description: Rends a guard with a cut that carries the whole weight of the swordsman's step.

name: Eddybarrage
description: Chops downward from a leap with the blade falling like a stone off the cliff.

name: Needling Pommeltuft
description: Thrusts along a bearing fixed on the opponent's heart before the step begins.

name: Waning Knotcord
description: Checks the held bearing against the opponent's movement and notes any drift.

name: Eddypounce
description: Corrects a drifting stance with a small step that returns the point to the bearing.

name: Unbroken Waistbend
description: Holds the guard on the bearing line so every cut meets the blade first.

name: Liltthrash
description: Slashes along a course that was held from the first step to the last.

name: Paralyzing Jianhilt
description: Crosses the opponent's bearing with the blade and holds it there to pin the cut.

name: Transfixing Swirl
description: Locks the point onto the bearing and drives it through whatever stands on the line.

name: Ravaging Flexspine
description: Sweeps along the held course in a long pass that does not waver at the end.

name: Unmaking Twinspine
description: Cuts while moving across open ground so the blade is never planted in one place.

name: Flexjaunt
description: Steps in any direction without a rear foot to anchor so no line is closed.

name: Enduring Pommeltuft
description: Guards by moving the blade with the wind so no cut finds it still.

name: Chime Tassel
description: Spreads the free hand wide to feel the air shift as the opponent moves.

name: Severing Flitter
description: Thrusts along a line the opponent has left unguarded as the stance shifts.

name: Tempered Eddy
description: Draws the edge across the opponent with a gust-like speed at the end of the pull.

name: Cleaving Lilt
description: Slashes across a wide front with nothing to limit the swing of the arm.

name: Unshaken Jianhilt
description: Turns the body with the blade in a gale-fast spin that carries any cut wide.

name: Subduing Knotcord
description: Presses the opposing blade down and out until the opponent has no ground to answer from.

name: Harrowing Flitter
description: Rides a gale along a single straight line in a thrust that no guard can step aside from.

name: Wrecking Eddy Maelstrom
description: Spins the blade in a rending gust that cuts every foe along the sweep of the arm.
